==Description==
'''Space Suit''', internally referred to as '''Astronaut''', is a cosmetic [[Modifiers|modifier]] that adds astronaut helmets onto every enemy.

'''Space Suit''' appears exclusively in [[Moon Base]]; it is active in all matches on that map.

==Effects==
When active, '''Space Suit''' modifier will add astronaut helmets onto every enemy. It will be overridden by the [[Cowboy (Modifier)|Cowboy]] modifier when it is active on all maps.

On some enemies like the [[Normal]], the astronaut helmet may be much bigger than it should be.
